content_note: Every rule here is intent-only: a name, an id and a logic line that names the detections the rule would join. There is no query, schedule, severity or alert mapping, so nothing in this file can be imported into a tenant as-is. Author the rule in the XSIAM console from the logic line.

rules.logic: Fires when, on the same agent_hostname within the run window, the BIOC `GentleKiller Vulnerable Driver Service Created (ThrottleStop.sys BYOVD)`, the terminal ABIOC `BYOVD EDR-Kill Behavioral Anomaly — Anomalous Signed Vulnerable Driver Load (GentleKiller)`, the ABIOC `Post-BYOVD Hands-on-Keyboard Burst on a Blinded Host — Recon and SystemBC C2`, and the BIOC `Volume Shadow Copy Deletion via vssadmin/wmic (Pre-Encryption)` observe activity. It fuses driver-service-create -> vulnerable-driver-load -> sensor-telemetry-gap -> scheduled-task persistence -> recon + SystemBC C2 -> shadow-copy deletion into ONE Gentlemen-BYOVD-ransomware incident whose ordered evidence graph is exported verbatim as the POV forensic packet.
rules.name: The Gentlemen BYOVD Ransomware Chain — Full Causality Stitch
